description: Timeless charm and endless possibilities await in this classic traditional home, ideally located in San Francisco's highly sought-after Parkside neighborhood. Wake up to spectacular sunrises that fill the inviting living room with natural light, then unwind at day's end as colorful sunsets paint the sky from the upstairs bedrooms. Ocean views from the sunroom and upper level provide a beautiful backdrop to everyday living.
